## Use Intel One Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Intel One Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Intel One Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace",
  "editor.fontLigatures": true
}

Copy

## About the Intel One Mono coding font

Intel's legibility-focused monospace with optional programming ligatures. Intel One Mono is a free monospace coding font with programming ligatures.

Intel One Mono is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Intel One Mono FAQ

### Is Intel One Mono free?

Yes. Intel One Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Intel One Mono support ligatures?

Yes. Intel One Mono ships programming ligatures. Use the ligature switch above the specimen, or set "editor.fontLigatures": true in VS Code.

### Where can I get Intel One Mono?

Intel One Mono is available from GitHub. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
